# Data attributions

DORA downloads these public datasets for training and benchmarking. None of them is in this repository.
**A model DORA ships is trained only on synthetic data and on datasets marked *train* below** (licences that
allow it without share-alike terms: CC BY 4.0 or CC0). Datasets marked *eval-only* are benchmarks only. When
you use any of them, credit the authors as listed.

## Citations

- **`deepbacs-mreb`**: DeepBacs: Escherichia coli MreB denoising dataset. E. coli MreB-sfGFP, live cells; 2D noisy/clean pairs, 16-bit 512x512; 30 train, 5 test. Cite: Spahn et al., "DeepBacs for multi-task bacterial image analysis using open-source deep learning approaches", Communications Biology 5, 688 (2022).
- **`deepbacs-nucleoid`**: DeepBacs: Escherichia coli nucleoid denoising dataset. E. coli H-NS-mScarlet-I, fixed cells; 2D noisy/clean pairs, 8-bit 512x512; 28 train, 2 test. Cite: Spahn et al., "DeepBacs for multi-task bacterial image analysis using open-source deep learning approaches", Communications Biology 5, 688 (2022).
- **`deepbacs-bsubtilis`**: DeepBacs: Bacillus subtilis denoising dataset. B. subtilis FtsZ-GFP frames; noisy only, 16-bit 1024x1024; 3 images. Cite: Spahn et al., "DeepBacs for multi-task bacterial image analysis using open-source deep learning approaches", Communications Biology 5, 688 (2022).
- **`zerocost-care2d`**: ZeroCostDL4Mic: CARE (2D) example training and test dataset. 2D noisy/clean pairs, float32 1024x1024; 22 train, 2 test; pixel-correlated noise. Cite: von Chamier et al., "Democratising deep learning for microscopy with ZeroCostDL4Mic", Nature Communications 12, 2276 (2021).
- **`mdc24-w2s`**: AI4Life-MDC24 challenge data: W2S subset. Widefield, 120 fields of view x 3 channels, noisy only (the challenge holds the references); one ImageJ hyperstack, int16 512x512. Cite: Zhou et al., "W2S: Microscopy Data with Joint Denoising and Super-Resolution for Widefield to SIM Mapping", ECCV 2020 Workshops, LNCS 12535 (2020); AI4Life Microscopy Denoising Challenge 2024 (unsupervised).
- **`mdc24-support`**: AI4Life-MDC24 challenge data: SUPPORT subset (Penicillium). One volume of 1001 z-slices (0.1 um), noisy only; ImageJ stack, uint16 1024x1024, big-endian. Cite: Eom et al., "Statistically unbiased prediction enables accurate denoising of voltage imaging data", Nature Methods 20, 1581-1592 (2023); AI4Life Microscopy Denoising Challenge 2024 (unsupervised).
- **`mdc24-jump`**: AI4Life-MDC24 challenge data: JUMP Cell Painting subset. 517 fields of view x 4 channels with added Gaussian noise, noisy only; ImageJ hyperstack, float32 540x540. Cite: Chandrasekaran et al., JUMP Cell Painting dataset cpg0016-jump, Cell Painting Gallery on the Registry of Open Data on AWS; AI4Life Microscopy Denoising Challenge 2024 (unsupervised).
- **`mdc25-tribolium`**: AI4Life-MDC25 challenge data: Tribolium (supervised training set). 15,500 paired 3D training patches (16 z-slices of 64x64, float32), noisy/ and gt/ by file name. Cite: Weigert et al., "Content-aware image restoration: pushing the limits of fluorescence microscopy", Nature Methods 15, 1090-1097 (2018); AI4Life Microscopy Supervised Denoising Challenge 2025.
- **`mdc25-planaria`**: AI4Life-MDC25 challenge data: Planaria (supervised training set). 17,900 paired 3D patches (16x64x64) and 45 paired volumes (up to 1024x1024 in-plane); noisy/ and gt/ by file name. Cite: Weigert et al., "Content-aware image restoration: pushing the limits of fluorescence microscopy", Nature Methods 15, 1090-1097 (2018); AI4Life Microscopy Supervised Denoising Challenge 2025.
- **`biosr-ccps`**: BioSR+: clathrin-coated pits. Raw SIM frames at 8 signal levels per cell, each with a high-SNR partner; MRC stacks (uint16). Cite: Qiao, "BioSR+: Dataset Extension of biological images for super-resolution microscopy", Zenodo (2022).
- **`biosr-er`**: BioSR+: endoplasmic reticulum. Raw SIM frames at several signal levels per cell, each with a high-SNR partner; MRC stacks (uint16). Cite: Qiao, "BioSR+: Dataset Extension of biological images for super-resolution microscopy", Zenodo (2022).
- **`biosr-microtubules`**: BioSR+: microtubules. Raw SIM frames at several signal levels per cell, each with a high-SNR partner; MRC stacks (uint16). Cite: Qiao, "BioSR+: Dataset Extension of biological images for super-resolution microscopy", Zenodo (2022).
- **`biosr-f-actin`**: BioSR+: F-actin. Raw SIM frames at several signal levels per cell, each with a high-SNR partner; MRC stacks (uint16). Cite: Qiao, "BioSR+: Dataset Extension of biological images for super-resolution microscopy", Zenodo (2022).
- **`biosr-myosin-iia`**: BioSR+: Myosin-IIA. Raw SIM frames at several signal levels per cell, each with a high-SNR partner; MRC stacks (uint16). Cite: Qiao, "BioSR+: Dataset Extension of biological images for super-resolution microscopy", Zenodo (2022).
- **`deepcad-zebrafish-regions`**: DeepCAD-RT dataset: zebrafish multiple brain regions. Two-photon calcium imaging (GCaMP6s), 9,800 frames of 485x400, paired low/high SNR; BigTIFF, uint16. Cite: Li et al., "Real-time denoising enables high-sensitivity fluorescence time-lapse imaging beyond the shot-noise limit", Nature Biotechnology 41, 282-292 (2023).
- **`deepcad-neutrophils`**: DeepCAD-RT dataset: mouse brain neutrophils. Two-photon time-lapses of motile neutrophils, 6,440 and 5,706 frames of 512x512, paired low/high SNR; ImageJ stacks, uint16, big-endian. Cite: Li et al., "Real-time denoising enables high-sensitivity fluorescence time-lapse imaging beyond the shot-noise limit", Nature Biotechnology 41, 282-292 (2023).
- **`deepcad-zebrafish-ot`**: DeepCAD-RT dataset: zebrafish optic tectum neurons. Two-photon calcium imaging (GCaMP6s), 6,955 frames of 492x492, paired low/high SNR; BigTIFF, uint16. Cite: Li et al., "Real-time denoising enables high-sensitivity fluorescence time-lapse imaging beyond the shot-noise limit", Nature Biotechnology 41, 282-292 (2023).
- **`fmd`**: Fluorescence Microscopy Denoising (FMD) dataset. Confocal, two-photon and widefield, 12 categories plus the test_mix benchmark; 5 noise levels with averaged references. Cite: Zhang et al., "A Poisson-Gaussian Denoising Dataset with Real Fluorescence Microscopy Images", CVPR 2019 (arXiv:1812.10366).

## Considered and not used

- **aydin-examples** (doi:10.5281/zenodo.18686251): the record is CC BY 4.0, but its file list gives per-file terms (CC BY-SA 4.0 for the OpenCell volumes, 'PI-confirmed redistribution' for several others), and its TIFFs are zstd-compressed, which DORA's reader doesn't decode.
- **deepcad-rt-demo**: the DeepCAD-RT demo data is GPL-licensed.
- **hagen-structured-noise**: Convallaria, mouse actin and mouse nuclei (the 2024 challenge's structured-noise sets): no licence found yet.
